rows.english: Choose an image format and its compression settings. Save will reuse this file name, location, format and settings.

Tlen tictlapehpenqui hueli quipatla quezqui bytes monequi para quiahcocuiz. Quemman zampa tictequihuia “Xicahcocui”, AN Paint zampa quiahcocuiz campa tictlapehpenqui, ica ni tocaitl, ica tlen tictlapehpenqui pan “Queniuhqui AN Paint quiahcocuiz” huan quen tictlapehpenqui ma quiahcocui.

rows.backtranslation: Choose in “How AN Paint will store” [File format]. Also choose how AN Paint will store the image. What you selected can change how many bytes are needed for storing it. After output write succeeds, non-exporting path replaces savedTarget with URI, name and all options and calls markSaved. Later requestSave reuses target URI and options. This is saved-state bookkeeping, not a claim that the artwork is complete or no losses occurred.
limits: The exact adopted File format anchor Queniuhqui AN Paint quiahcocuiz must remain matched. Xicahcocui is the actual Save control.

Compression settings are described as the chosen manner of image storage that can change required byte count, without low-byte objective or guaranteed reduction. No direct numerical-byte control is asserted.
Own Chicontepec sourced composition, no complete published phrase/native/layout/runtime certification.
